name: Drop Dead, Gorgeous
source:
In the middle of the end of the world, Amelia's new girlfriend (of 1 day) has just been turned into a zombie. But is she still in there? Somewhere?

[From [url=https://snatch-gaymes.itch.io/drop-dead-gorgeous]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界正在走向末日，阿梅莉娅刚交往一天的女朋友又变成了丧尸。可那个她，会不会还在？藏在这副躯壳的某个角落？

（来源：[url=https://snatch-gaymes.itch.io/drop-dead-gorgeous]itch.io[/url]）
